title: Goongɗinɗo Suuɗiiɗo
intro: E nder cuuɗi laamu ɓuuɓɗi, ɗo keefeeraagal e njurum laami, daande goonga wootere ina haalda e nokku mo sikkaano. Ndeeɗoo limoore ina luulndii laamu nguu ngam reende nulaaɗo, riisde kisal mum en ngam bayyinde goonga.
clues: Miɗo wuuri e leydi njurum mawndi, miɗo gollina laamɗo wiyoowo ko laamɗo.
Miɗo suuɗii geɗe am goonga ɗee duuɓi keewɗi, miɗo hula batte feeñninde ɗe.
So nulaaɗo arii ina jogii maandeeji laaɓɗi, mi gooŋɗini, kono leñol am ina fijira mbo.
Mi dariima yeeso jom doole en e diɗɗal mum, miɗo wiya yo ɓe mbaru nulaaɗo mo alaa ko boni.
Mi jeertinii 6e jukkungo lexxi gadii6e calii6e goonga, hono yim6e Nuuhu e yim6e Aad.
Allah danndi kam e peeje maɓɓe bonɗe, mi seedtii bonnagol laamu tooñannge.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Hisnaama e bonannde nde tooñooɓe ɓee ndartinaa
Wertaa e yiite, yalti alaa ko bonnata
Waɗii duuɓi capanɗe nay e nder ladde
outcome.answer: Hisnaama e bonannde nde tooñooɓe ɓee ndartinaa

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
